core.modules.githubToken.label: GitHub token
core.modules.githubToken.description: Optional: for private repositories and higher rate limits (read access is enough).

core.modules.allowedSources.label: Allowed sources
core.modules.allowedSources.description: Optional: one `owner/repo` or `owner/*` per line. Empty = all GitHub sources and ZIP files allowed; otherwise no ZIP files.

core.system.locale.label: Language
core.system.locale.description: Language for everyone who hasn't chosen their own. “Automatic” follows the browser language (otherwise German).

core.org.everyoneLabel.label: Name for “everyone”
core.org.everyoneLabel.description: What sharing with all people is called, e.g. “Everyone”, “Club” or “Team”. Empty = “Everyone” in the current language.

core.legal.privacyUrl.label: Privacy policy (URL)
core.legal.privacyUrl.description: Link to your organization's privacy policy. Shown on the sign-in page and all public pages; registration forms without their own link use it.

core.legal.imprintUrl.label: Legal notice (URL)
core.legal.imprintUrl.description: Link to the legal notice (imprint). Shown on the sign-in page and all public pages.

core.retention.apiLogDays.label: Keep API log (days)
core.retention.apiLogDays.description: Entries in the API access log (path, IP address, actor) are deleted after this. 1–3650 days.

core.retention.auditIpDays.label: Keep IP addresses in the audit log (days)
core.retention.auditIpDays.description: After this, the IP address is removed from audit entries; the entry itself stays. 1–3650 days.

core.retention.auditDays.label: Keep audit log (days)
core.retention.auditDays.description: Audit entries are deleted after this. 0 = never delete, otherwise at least 30 days (at most 36500).

core.design.iconBackground.label: App icon background
core.design.iconBackground.description: Fill color behind the logo for app icons on the home screen (iOS, Android). Favicon and logo stay transparent.

core.mail.layoutEnabled.label: Use the organization layout for emails
core.mail.layoutEnabled.description: Header with logo and organization name, signature and footer for all outgoing emails.

core.mail.signature.label: Signature
core.mail.signature.description: Added below every message, e.g. “Best regards”. Empty = no signature.

core.mail.footerText.label: Footer
core.mail.footerText.description: Small print below every email (e.g. registration details). Empty = no footer.

core.ai.monthlyTokenLimit.label: Monthly token limit per module (0 = unlimited)

core.ai.monthlyCostLimitUsd.label: Monthly cost limit per module in USD (0 = unlimited)

core.ai.pricing.label: Prices per 1M tokens in USD (model -> input/output)

core.ai.userMonthlyTokenLimit.label: Writing assistant: token limit per person and month (0 = unlimited)

core.ai.style.address.label: Writing assistant: form of address (default, can be changed per text)

core.ai.style.tone.label: Writing assistant: tone
core.ai.style.tone.description: How your organization's texts should sound, e.g. “friendly, relaxed, clear”.

core.ai.style.context.label: Writing assistant: who is writing?
core.ai.style.context.description: Short description of the organization and its readers, e.g. “a sports club, texts for members and parents”. Empty = general.

core.ai.style.notes.label: Writing assistant: further style notes
core.ai.style.notes.description: Applies to all suggestions, e.g. “Club name: …” or “no emojis”.

core.ai.assist.allowInbox.label: Writing assistant: send received emails for reply drafts
core.ai.assist.allowInbox.description: The email text is sent to the AI provider (email addresses, phone numbers and IBANs are masked first).

core.ai.assist.allowImages.label: Writing assistant: send gallery images for image descriptions
core.ai.assist.allowImages.description: The image is sent to the AI provider without metadata.

core.push.enabled.label: Push notifications
core.push.enabled.description: Allows notifications directly on the device (Web Push, also as an app on the home screen). Off: everything goes by email.

core.user.themes.label: Own themes
core.user.themes.description: Personal themes (accent color and background per mode).

core.user.activeTheme.label: Active theme
core.user.activeTheme.description: Empty = no theme, `preset:<name>` = suggestion, otherwise ID of an own theme.

core.user.themeFavorites.label: Favorite themes
core.user.themeFavorites.description: Themes marked with a star; only these appear in the header.

core.user.startPage.label: Start page
core.user.startPage.description: Page after signing in (only allowed pages are used).

core.user.dashboard.label: Dashboard layout
core.user.dashboard.description: Order and hidden tiles (`<module>:<tile>`); empty = default.

validation.auditDays: Please enter 0 (never) or at least 30 days

errors.userIdRequired: User-specific setting requires a user ID
errors.ownOnly: Only your own settings can be changed
